raw_segments.text: Nor wanting power to mitigate and swage with solemn touches troubled thoughts and chase anguish and doubt and fear and sorrow and pain
Thus they breathing united force with fixed thought
moved on in silence to soft pipes that charmed their painful steps or the burnt soil and now advanced in view they stand a
horrid front of dreadful length and dazzling arms in guys of warriors old with ordered spear and shield
Awaiting what command their mighty chief had to impose
He threw the armed files darts his experienced eye and soon traversed the whole battalion views
Their order due their visages and stature as of gods
